title: Toggle Chat Mod
description: Easily enable/disable chat with a press of a single button!
body:
# 🔥Toggle Chat Mod

- Need to hide your chat for various reasons?
- To lazy to scroll through settings to enable/disable chat?
- Easily enable/disable chat with a press of a single button!

![showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/vTXLQ1AM/images/a5a1baa4f6b2ab323d3a30d24379302f19afe411.gif)
